dominant_breach: LTSS spenddown and Medicaid estate recovery against modest home equity
fastest_washout: late-life care need and posthumous recovery

intergenerational_transfer_gate.note: Medicaid LTSS can preserve care access while also exposing low/modest home equity to recovery, making care and family transfer a single claim-conversion problem.

medicaid_estate_recovery_scope.note: Recovery scope must be scored by federal minimums, state options, probate/nonprobate estate definition, survivor exceptions, hardship waivers, notice, and claim settlement.

long_term_care_home_equity_spenddown.note: LTSS need can force spenddown before public support or trigger posthumous recovery, which distinguishes modest-home families from planning-equipped wealthy families.

caregiver_inheritance_recognition.note: Caregiver, survivor, disabled-child, hardship, and delayed-recovery protections require proof of claimability and actual uptake.

proof_debt: state estate-recovery scope and estate definition
survivor, hardship, caregiver, and disabled-child protections

gate_19_intergenerational_transfer.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: state estate-recovery scope and estate definition
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Build a state table for mandatory/optional recovery, probate and expanded estate definitions, liens, TEFRA rules, notice, and settlements.

evidence_debt_register.question: survivor, hardship, caregiver, and disabled-child protections
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether survivor exceptions and undue-hardship waivers are automatic, understandable, timely, and actually granted.

evidence_debt_register.question: home-equity spenddown before recovery
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Pair LTSS cost, eligibility resource limits, home-equity exemptions, and estate-recovery claims by age, race, and family wealth.

evidence_debt_register.question: revenue recovered versus intergenerational harm
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Compare state recovery revenue, administrative costs, deterrence from care, and household wealth loss.

validation_notes: rev0331 promotes this scoreboard from seed to active in the Gate 18/19 backlog-closure pass; certification remains blocked until operational claim conversion and outcome evidence are shown.
